benchmark.name: LLM-MSE-MCQs

summary.en: LLM-MSE-MCQs is the fixed multiple-choice materials-science subset of LLM-MSE, testing undergraduate materials knowledge and reasoning.
summary.zh: LLM-MSE-MCQs 是 LLM-MSE 中固定的材料科学 multiple-choice 子集，测试模型的本科材料知识和推理能力。

task_format.en: The model answers a fixed 113-question multiple-choice subset covering undergraduate materials science. ScienceEval's comparable panel samples eight responses per question for pass@1 estimation.
task_format.zh: 模型回答固定的 113 道本科材料科学 multiple-choice question。ScienceEval 的可比 panel 对每道题采样八次，用于估计 pass@1。

explanation.en: The score is the fraction of fixed LLM-MSE-MCQs questions answered correctly under the standardized ScienceEval panel. Other LLM-MSE datasets and prompting variants are separate measurement objects.
explanation.zh: 分数是在标准化 ScienceEval panel 下答对固定 LLM-MSE-MCQs 题目的比例。LLM-MSE 的其他 dataset 和 prompting variant 属于独立 measurement object。

observations.evaluation_protocol: LLM-MSE-MCQs fixed 113-question multiple-choice subset; ScienceEval standardized panel with eight samples per question. LLM-MSE steel-yield and band-gap prediction datasets, expert prompts, and few-shot variants are not merged.

benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
